services.name: One Hour Jet Ski Rental
services.desc: Ready to have a blast? We are the only truly unguided jet ski rental company located in Panama City Beach. We offer hourly, half day and daily rentals. Duration & 2 hours: $199 About Jet ski rentals are fun for the entire family. Since we are located so close to Shell Island and the dolphins, you get to spend most of your time enjoying the sights of the island, its sugar sands and the friendly bottlenose dolphins. We are only a 5-10 minute ride from Shell Island and the dolphins.
